title: Topological traps in evolutionary games
summary: How cooperation originates and persists among self-interested individuals is a central question in the social and behavioural sciences. In the canonical two-dimensional spatial Prisoner's Dilemma with unconditional imitation introduced by Nowak and May (1992), simulations on a Moore lattice show an abrupt drop in cooperation near the temptation $T\approx5/3$, yet even under these harsh conditions cooperative structures can still arise.
